maya (People Ops): Heads-up — last-minute coverage needed for an interview today at 2:00pm PST. Interviewer called in sick. Candidate has a submitted take-home + 30m live coding. Can someone cover the live session and take scribe for the debrief?

sahil (Eng Hiring): I can run the live coding at 2pm. I have oncall 3–5pm so ideally someone else does the debrief/scribe.

alex (ML Infra): I can take the scribe and run the debrief. Quick Q: what scoring format are we using this round? numeric 1-5 + freeform? Any weight to take-home vs live?

jordan (Interviewer): For infra hires we usually do 1-5 for each axis + required comments. Weighting last round was take-home 60 / live 40, but hiring manager prefers 50/50 this time. Please confirm with hiring lead.

maya (People Ops): Thanks — noted. I'll mark 50/50 for this slate unless hiring lead objects within 30m.

alex (ML Infra): Cool. Tentative schedule:
```
Candidate: Kim T.
13:30 PST - internal read of take-home (30m) - alex (prep)
14:00 PST - live coding (30m) - sahil (interviewer)
14:30 PST - debrief (15m) - alex (scribe)
```

sahil (Eng Hiring): That works. One more ask — I'm juggling a CR that needs attention before oncall. If someone can ping or merge `#3421` after the live session that'd help. I'll try to get a quick pass at 13:45.

alex (ML Infra): I can review `#3421` after the debrief and merge if green. @sahil put me as reviewer.

people-ops-bot: Calendar updated: "Interview — Kim T." added to 2:00pm PST, guests: sahil, alex, hiring-lead. Join link -> https://meet.redwood.example/xyz123

maya (People Ops): @sahil all set — I've updated the calendar and flagged the scribe. Hiring lead (cc @jordan) please flag if you need different weighting.

jordan (Interviewer): Fine with 50/50. Also please check the evaluation form: use the "infra checklist" section and tick the "operational-experience" box. Link: https://intra.redwood/evals/infra-form

sahil (Eng Hiring): :thumbsup: I'll be on deck at 13:50 for quick sync and will join the live session at 14:00. Thanks @alex and @maya.

alex (ML Infra): I'll take notes in the debrief doc and post the short writeup in hiring GH issue after.

people-ops-bot: Reminder set — 15min before interview.

maya (People Ops): Great teamwork — closing loop. If anyone needs to swap again, post here asap.
_meta: generated for dataset: single slack thread representing interview logistics + quick eng coord
